blocks.title: Claude Code on the host, keel-web beside it
Workspaces the developer adds, selects and keeps

consultations.question: Are the functional goals and problems read correctly, and where does the keel-web process itself run once Claude Code runs on the host?
options: keel-web stays containerised, host paths reach it through a mount or a host-side helper
keel-web moves to the host as well, the container becomes a convenience only
undecided, treat it as a step 6 option
consultations.answer: keel-web itself moves to the host alongside Claude Code, so server, registry, transcript log and agent share one filesystem; compose stays as a development convenience. Distribution as an image is a constraint to keep open, not a deliverable of this ticket. Goals and problems confirmed as stated.

consultations.question: Is the split into b1 (host runtime and agent) and b2 (workspace management) the right cut, and is b1 first the right order?
options: Two blocks as proposed, b1 before b2
One block for the whole ticket
consultations.answer: Two blocks as proposed, b1 (host runtime and agent) before b2 (workspace management).

consultations.question: Does knowledge.md record the ticket correctly before the block zone starts?
options: Correct a goal, problem or answer first
consultations.answer: Accepted as written. Proceed to block b1, step 6.

consultations.question: Which solution options does b1 take: how 'not logged in' is detected, what happens to configDirectory, what happens to the container, and whether the SSE invariant is observed or enforced?
options: Auth: file probe / claude auth status --json / through the SDK with no pre-flight
configDirectory: keep as an explicit input passed into the agent env / delete it
Container: equal second path / delete / tests and CI only
SSE invariant: read in the log / asserted by an automated test
consultations.answer: Auth: no pre-flight probe; a start that fails before system:init ever arrived is classified as not logged in. configDirectory: kept, and now actually passed to the agent as Options.env spread over process.env. Container: kept for tests and CI only, no Claude login inside it, claude_config volume and the devcontainer Claude feature removed. SSE: the one-detach-per-reload invariant becomes an automated in-process test against the Hono router, no new route. Also agreed without a question: serve() binds 127.0.0.1 and vite's host: true is dropped.

consultations.question: Are the LikeC4 deployment model, the frozen contracts and the two ADRs right for b1? Everything after this is implemented against them.
